publicBoundaryFindings.finding: resetHTMLSanitizer is exported by security.ts but NOT part of the public package entry (index.ts). Only setHTMLSanitizer is public. Restoration to identity must use the public setter.
publicBoundaryFindings.consequence: The genuine default NoOpSanitizer is a private unexported class; tests that depend on pristine default (API-063 identity, API-064 warning) run before any setter call.

orderingConstraint: Pristine-default assertions (API-063 default identity; API-064 default-sanitizer warning) run first in the file, before any setHTMLSanitizer call, because the private NoOpSanitizer default cannot be reconstructed through the public surface. T1-R (T1-F02): the sanitizer registry is process-global; isolation is bounded by ordering, and after this file the global is left as the identity-behaviour sanitizer (not the pristine default). A T1-F02 post-condition test pins that end-of-file state.

mixedCaseAttributeFindings.conclusion: createElement blocks only names starting with lowercase 'on' and the exact string 'style'. Mixed-case variants bypass and are applied; a bypassed ONCLICK installs a live inline handler. This is characterization of current behavior; the default sanitizer is a no-op and this is NOT presented as XSS protection.
